title: AI Site Settings: A Tour of Settings, Artificial Intelligence | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The CrestApps AI features share one settings page. This tour of Settings > Artificial Intelligence covers the General options, the default deployments, preemptive retrieval, the data source defaults and the cards that other features add.

In this video:
• How the cards of the page follow the enabled features
• General: memory retrieval, maximum iterations, caching, OpenTelemetry
• Default deployments: chat, utility, embedding, vision, image, speech and realtime
• The Default Orchestrator and the Data Sources defaults
• Chat Interactions, Documents, MCP Server and Memory
